# Ataturk dies. Vanilla's turkey.1 only fires without Battle for the Bosporus; with the DLC his
# death runs through the vanilla focus tree, which WiF replaces - so WiF kills him here.
country_event = {
	id = wif_tur.1
	title = wif_tur.1.t
	desc = wif_tur.1.desc
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_funeral
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = TUR
		has_dlc = "Battle for the Bosporus"
		date > 1938.11.1
		NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_tur_ataturk_dead }
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 15
		modifier = { factor = 0.2 date > 1938.12.1 }
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_global_flag = wif_tur_ataturk_dead
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_leader = { character = TUR_mustafa_kemal_ataturk ruling_only = yes } }
				kill_country_leader = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_character = TUR_mustafa_kemal_ataturk }
				retire_character = TUR_mustafa_kemal_ataturk
			}
			wif_tur_assembly_leads = yes
		}
	}
	option = { name = wif_tur.1.a }
}
